title: B3 Rolling-Window Systemic-Risk Data and Reproducibility Materials, 1995-2025
description: This dataset and reproducibility package supports the manuscript 'Taxonomy of Critical Phenomena in Financial Markets'. It contains the data products, validation outputs, PMFG network edge lists, rolling network metrics, centrality and community measures, figures, configuration files, and the self-contained Paper 1 pipeline used to analyze 360 monthly rolling windows of Brazilian B3 equity networks from 1995 to 2025. The study compares four pre-specified core stress events and an eleven-anchor sensitivity calendar comprising one additional 1999 trigger and six fallback local-drop anchors. The analysis is retrospective and descriptive: the materials document heterogeneous structural variation around dated stress anchors and do not provide causal, predictive, or early-warning evidence.
notes: The dedicated Paper 1 code repository is public at https://github.com/gersonncardoso/taxonomy-critical-phenomena-financial-markets. The published Zenodo record is https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22037008.
